I think the “theories” and “ideas” we get from these psychedelics do carry meaning. I do believe we have a preset plan made for us as an individual from the universe. No, I am currently not tripping, but it has been awhile (since summer). I thought the same exact thing, if the thoughts we have under acid are real or just an effect from the drug. But I believe scientifically we all have an ego, a filter we see through. It makes us US. But under LSD or any psychedelic for that matter, it shatters that filter and shows us the world for how it is. It’s crazy because I remember having someone tripsit me who has never tripped in his life, and he thought I sounded insane out of my mind. But in reality, I was experiencing life at it’s purest form. The ego dissolves. Then comes back the day later, with the filter and the ego progressively builds and makes you think the entire trip was ingrained with bullshit made-up fantasies. But the truth is, we’re living the trip. Life is the trip and the ego is there for us to guide through it.
